summary.one_liner: Deluge is a cross-platform BitTorrent client built on a daemon/client model, with GTK, web, and console interfaces, using libtorrent for the protocol.
summary.what_it_does: Deluge runs as a daemon (deluged) that handles BitTorrent transfers, and separate front-ends connect to it. The README describes three user interfaces: a GTK UI (deluge or deluge-gtk), a console UI (deluge-console), and a web UI (deluge-web). It uses libtorrent as the core engine for the BitTorrent protocol. It can be installed from PyPI with pip, with an optional "all" extra for additional dependencies, or from source. The README notes that a thin-client guide explains how to connect to the daemon from another computer.
use_cases: run a torrent client on a headless server
manage torrents from a web browser
how_to_run: deluge  (or deluge-gtk) for the GTK UI
deluge-web for the web UI (default password: deluge); deluged to start the daemon
notable: Daemon/client architecture: one deluged backend can be driven by several front-ends
Three interfaces: GTK, web, and console
Thin-client support for connecting to the daemon from another machine
Uses libtorrent as the BitTorrent engine
caveats: Web UI ships with a default password (deluge) that should be changed
Optional dependencies are needed for the full feature set (pip install deluge[all]); see DEPENDS for details
